cover_letter_content.title: James Valeii
cover_letter_content.content: I am excited to apply for the {{hiring_position}} role. I build client-facing websites that balance visual polish, performance, and maintainability. I consult with clients to document requirements, design site appearance and flow, and source and optimize content. I implement interactive features using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and integrate with backend services (MySQL, Git). I also create and prepare assets with Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, run security and quality tests, and tune caching for fast, reliable experiences. I thrive in fast-paced, client-focused consulting environments, meet tight deadlines, and communicate clearly with stakeholders and team members.
